Hi team, I'm working on LEDGERLIB-108 (aging_bucket). My implementation follows the spec in the docstring and the design-review note (<=0 current, 1-30 is 1-30, etc.). However, the acceptance test `test_regression_issue_261` asserts `aging_bucket(1) == 'current'`, which contradicts the spec. This looks like a stale test. Has anyone seen issue #261 or know if this test needs updating? I don't want to merge a wrong implementation just to pass a faulty test.

Hi team, blocking issue for LEDGERLIB-122: `src/ledgerlib/due_date.py` (owned by @eng-54) currently raises `NotImplementedError`. My `aging_report` implementation depends on it. @eng-54, could you please prioritize implementing `due_date`? The spec expects it to return an ISO date string given an invoice date (ISO string) and net_days (int). Thanks!
